experience.summary: A home-use transpalpebral tonometer for monitoring glaucoma-related eye pressure. Built the Bluetooth link, closed-loop motor control, signal filtering and calibration, and finite-element simulations of the eyelid and eyeball. Outputs include embedded modules for the device, a simulation workflow and 3 invention patent applications; the project won Second Prize at the National Medical Insurance Innovation Competition.

experience.org: XJTLU Academy of Artificial Intelligence · University of Liverpool
experience.summary: Deep learning for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer in MRI, with Assoc. Prof. Hong-Seng Gan. Designed the ReFER and PAD-Former models, ran benchmark studies on a Slurm cluster, and handles day-to-day administration of the group's GPU platforms (an NVIDIA A800 cluster and two 8-GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell servers): user accounts, container environments and job scheduling. Produced first-author papers at IEEE BIBM 2025 and 2026, a read-only audit of the two RTX PRO 6000 servers, and a written proposal for unified Slurm scheduling.

experience.role: Multi-Channel Miniaturised Wireless Electrochemical Sensing Platform
experience.summary: Supervised by Dr Qifeng Lu (Associate Professor, School of CHIPS). A multi-channel, multi-protocol electrochemical acquisition platform for the sensors developed in Dr Lu's group, extending the open-source NanoStat design. Handles system design, firmware and host software; so far a redesigned board supports four-channel electrochemical acquisition and skin-impedance measurement, with web-based host software, and wearable integration is the next step.

An open-source hardware security key for OTP and FIDO2 authentication, building on Google OpenSK and incubated at XJTLU's entrepreneurship hub. Co-founded the company and leads embedded software development in Rust on Tock OS. Shipped 100+ units in small batches.

Evaluation of large models and AI-coding products at Volcano Engine. Benchmarked large models on reasoning, coding, tool use and instruction following, and analysed LLM-agent products and AI-coding workflows. Delivered evaluation reports and triaged community issues for product and engineering teams.
Zhipu AI's campus programme at XJTLU. Gave technical talks on LLM inference infrastructure (vLLM, SGLang) and set up a Dify campus partnership. Hosted a Dify-based agent hackathon for students.

A wheeled-biped robot. Developed gait control and motor-control interfaces in a master–slave design, using a Raspberry Pi 5 for planning, SLAM and obstacle avoidance. Gave public technical talks on the company's AI and robotics products.

experience.org: Fudan University · Intelligent Perception & Autonomous Systems Lab
experience.summary: An autonomous research vehicle on ROS 2. Built LiDAR perception, SLAM localisation, path planning and motion control on a Jetson NX and integrated them into one ROS 2 navigation pipeline.

experience.org: East China Normal University · Intelligent Ultrasound Research Center
experience.summary: Biomedical electronics for electrical stimulation and sitting-posture monitoring. Core developer of a multi-channel electrical-stimulation system (firmware, wireless links, Flutter control app, bio-impedance closed-loop output) and of a pressure-array cushion that recognises sitting posture.
Large-format FDM 3D printers. Designed and assembled printers, simulated delta kinematics in SolidWorks, and configured Marlin firmware for motor and sensor control.

outreach.summary: XJTLU's student science and technology association (200+ members). Served two terms as president and led development of the X-SIA member platform. Co-organised NVIDIA China Developer Day at XJTLU (~200 attendees).
Developer-tool and engineering-software outreach. Provided on-site technical support for JetBrains at Apsara Conference 2024 and 2025. Ran MATLAB and Simulink campus outreach at XJTLU for MathWorks.
